geometry.pattern: The service status overlapped the compact map rail near the header.
geometry.cause: The rail used the desktop top offset at the compact breakpoint.
geometry.avdsContract: Semantic control surfaces need a clear, non-overlapping compact composition.
geometry.fix: Raised the compact rail offset to top-40 while keeping the desktop offset at sm:top-28.

geometry.pattern: Both compact rails could consume the map viewport when opened together.
geometry.cause: Layer and intelligence controls had independent open state.
geometry.avdsContract: Compact controls should preserve a usable primary viewport.
geometry.fix: Made the compact rails mutually exclusive; each edge toggle remains available.

radii.pattern: Status and control surfaces lacked a shared semantic corner treatment.
radii.cause: The compact overlay surfaces did not use a shared adapter token.
radii.fix: Applied the AVDS adapter control radius to the status and compact control surfaces.

typography.pattern: Faux operational metrics and classified-language labels obscured the product hierarchy.
typography.cause: Decorative surveillance-style labels substituted for the actual product and service state.
typography.avdsContract: Product identity and service state must be legible, semantic, and source-aware.
typography.fix: Replaced fabricated metrics and labels with a direct product title and factual service-state copy.

space.pattern: Compact header, status surface, controls, and map viewport needed a stable visual separation.
space.cause: Desktop overlay spacing had not been adapted to the compact control sequence.
space.avdsContract: Compact spacing should keep primary controls and the map viewport independently usable.
space.fix: Separated the header, status surface, and rails; the browser evidence confirms the final compact layouts.
